purpose: Experiment E-SLF-0156 in the selves arena: the coherence-preserving route beats the shortest route: steered through a hazardous world by pure distance the self walks into the standing decoherence strip and loses most of its body, steered by the locally sensed hazard-aware field it detours through the corridor and delivers its charge whole, while in the benign control world the two routes tie, so the good path is findable from the local signal and invisible to geometry-only planning.
